mechanism: Changing the meeting schedule from IRC to Matrix makes the unchanged yaml2ical parser reject the newly valid source configuration.
repair_template: Extend the parser and calendar location model to accept Matrix while retaining IRC support and the existing source-native generation command.

semantic_review.a1_failure: With only the source opening revision present, the unchanged yaml2ical parser reaches the changed meeting file, reports the missing irc attribute, raises KeyError, and exits nonzero; the same signature is absent from A0 and A2.
semantic_review.reviewer_basis: The source and final maintainer target diffs, Gerrit opening chronology, the source repository's pre-existing tox ical command, parser code, and an independently run native-command pilot with exits 0/1/0 and 47 meetings generated in A0 and A2.
semantic_review.source_effect: The opening source revision changes the OpenDev meeting schedule from an irc field to a matrix field and updates the existing output template to render either location kind.
semantic_review.target_repair: The final maintainer revision changes yaml2ical to accept either irc or matrix, derives a common location field, updates calendar output and conflict comparison, and adds a Matrix parser test; it does not remove or skip the existing generation command. The final revision also corrects the initial patch set's erroneous boolean guard.
